mapper.insert: INSERT INTO notifications (user_id, type, source_id, agg_key, content, agg_count, last_event_at, is_read, created_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{type}, #{sourceId}, #{aggKey}, #{content}, COALESCE(#{aggCount}, 1), COALESCE(#{lastEventAt}, NOW()), 0, NOW()) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE agg_count = agg_count + 1, content = VALUES(content), last_event_at = VALUES(last_event_at), id = LAST_INSERT_ID(id)
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM notifications WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND is_read = 0
SELECT type as type, COUNT(*) as count FROM notifications WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND is_read = 0 GROUP BY type
mapper.update: UPDATE notifications SET is_read = 1 WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND is_read = 0
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM notifications WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND type = #{type} AND is_read = 0
